recognize_zh: 視野中幾乎全是大小相近的胚細胞，核質比極高、細胞質極少，染色質細緻至略顆粒狀，部分核有凹痕或不規則形狀，無顆粒與 Auer 小體，符合淋巴母細胞白血病；T 系需以流式確認。
features: Monotonous sheet of small to medium blasts
Very high N:C ratio with scant to barely visible cytoplasm
Finely stippled to slightly coarse chromatin with inconspicuous nucleoli
Round to irregular nuclei, some with indentations or folds
Absence of granules and Auer rods; rare small mature lymphocytes and a nucleated red cell
describe_en: Smear shows a monotonous population of small to medium-sized blasts with a very high N:C ratio, scant agranular cytoplasm, finely stippled chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli. Some nuclei are irregular with shallow indentations. Occasional small mature lymphocytes and a nucleated red cell are present, and Auer rods are absent. Findings are consistent with acute lymphoblastic leukemia, compatible with T-lymphoblastic leukemia in the appropriate immunophenotypic context (cytoplasmic CD3+, TdT+).

ddx.vs: Morphology overlaps completely, and lineage requires flow cytometry showing CD19/CD79a/CD10 rather than cytoplasmic CD3/CD7.
Myeloblasts are usually larger with more cytoplasm, prominent nucleoli, occasional granules or Auer rods and MPO positivity.
Burkitt cells have deeply basophilic cytoplasm with sharply punched-out lipid vacuoles and are surface immunoglobulin positive and TdT negative.
